reddit_posts.title: Security audit command for Claude Code — found 5 OWASP vulns in my own project
reddit_posts.body:
I built a Python security scanner that runs as a Claude Code slash command. It checks for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities including SQL injection, hardcoded secrets, eval() usage, and insecure deserialization.

Just drop it in your project and run: `python3 security-audit.py`

It caught 5 issues in my own codebase that I'd missed:
• 2 hardcoded API keys
• 1 SQL injection risk (f-string in query)
• 1 eval() usage
• 1 debug mode enabled

Full pack with 5 templates + 10 MCP configs + 8 commands: https://github.com/chengjunhua465-create/ai-dev-workflow-pack

Free tier available. Pro is $25 one-time.
